text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What a fierce contest between these<n>fantastic
senior racers!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The winner of today's race is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Good race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You too. You looked good out there,<n>as usual. But...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Things will be different tomorrow. I'llbe different tomorrow. So long as Iget another chance, I will win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Heh... And I'll be right there to take<n>you on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I think so too. I was able<n>to run at my
very best today.

As I see Biwa Hayahide smiling<n>proudly, a sense of
regret fills me.
choice_data_list:
(If only we'd known this race would be at Hanshin
from the beginning...)

text_block_list.text:
Then maybe she would've been able<n>to put on an
even better performance.<n>She might've...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This is incredible, folks! Narita Brian<n>has not only
won the race, she's set<n>a new record!
She might've even set a new record...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Earth to Trainer! What are you mulling<n>about so
seriously?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking about how you were so close to an
even better result.

I was thinking about how you were so close to an
even better result.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's certainly important not to<n>grow
complacent. And I agree—I'm<n>not satisfied with my
performance<n>today either.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to test myself at<n>the Takarazuka
Kinen next. I must if<n>I'm to be the best of my
generation.

The Takarazuka Kinen... Only the best<n>and most
famous Umamusume are<n>invited to take part in it.
Not only that...
choice_data_list: The Takarazuka Kinen is held at Hanshin, right?
The Takarazuka Kinen is held at Hanshin, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right. The length of the race is<n>different, but yes,
it's also held here<n>at the Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you still upset about the venue<n>change?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Goodness. There's no point fussing<n>over it. It's not
as if anything<n>could've been done about it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's just focus on the next race.<n>First, we should
look up who I'm<n>most likely to be up against in the
Takarazuka Kinen...

I do my best to leave my worries<n>behind and switch
gears to start<n>preparing for the Takarazuka Kinen
together with Biwa Hayahide.

This time, I'll make sure she can<n>really run at her
full potential!
